subject: POC: Atlas Payments - success criteria & trial KPI follow-up
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya@atlaspayments.com>, Samir Desai <samir@atlaspayments.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-06-18T15:23:00-07:00
Subject: POC: Atlas Payments - success criteria & trial KPI follow-up

Hi Priya / Samir 

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so were all aligned on the POC scope and how well measure success.

Recap (from todays demo + discovery)
- Goal: Replace current inference pipeline for payment classification & entity extraction with Redwood inference to reduce latency and inference cost while maintaining/exceeding current extraction accuracy.
- Primary models: production tuned LLM (instruction-following) + light reranker.
- Data: ~1M monthly requests, typical prompt length ~120 tokens, some up to 512 tokens.
- Constraints: PCI-sensitive fields redacted before sending to Redwood; SOC2 + data retention details required by your security team.

Proposed success criteria / KPIs to validate during the 3-week trial (please confirm or adjust):
1) Latency: P95 end-to-end inference latency <= 250 ms for 512-token requests (target 200 ms on Dedicated).
2) Throughput: Sustained 200-300 requests/sec with 95% success rate under expected batching policy.
3) Cost: Inference cost <= $0.0008 per token (target $0.0006 with quantization/batching).
4) Quality: >= 90% intent-match / extraction accuracy on a 1k labeled test set you provide.
5) Reliability: API availability >= 99.9%, and fallback behavior on overload tested.

Proposed evaluation plan / ownership:
- Atlas provides labeled 1k evaluation set + representative production traffic sample (Samir / Priya).
- Redwood will provide test harness, eval scripts, and a temporary dedicated environment (Alex).
- Redwood to run sensitivity tests for latency vs throughput (Alex) and provide tuning recommendations (Marissa).

Next steps (proposed):
- Priya: confirm success criteria and expected trial window (start date preference?).
- Samir: share security intake contact and any questionnaire items we should pre-populate.
- Redwood: send trial plan + SOW and propose kickoff call for environment setup.

I attached a one-page POC map and a draft trial plan (see attachments) to make the kickoff faster.

If this looks good Ill schedule a 30-min kickoff next week and create an action tracker.

Thanks 

Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales (Payments)
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Atlas-POC-MAP.pdf (PDF, 245 KB)]
[Attachment: Redwood-POC-trial-plan.xlsx (XLSX, 56 KB)]

From: Priya Shah <priya@atlaspayments.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Desai <samir@atlaspayments.com>
Date: 2029-06-18T19:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC: Atlas Payments - success criteria & trial KPI follow-up

Jordan 

Thanks for the clear recap. Were aligned on the goals and the proposed success criteria with a few adjustments from our side:

Adjustments / confirmations:
- Latency: Aim for P95 <= 200 ms on the dedicated environment for 512-token requests. If we can hit <=200 ms well consider latency green.
- Throughput: Well target 250 reqs/sec sustained (burst to 400 for short periods). Please validate batching behavior against our traffic pattern.
- Cost: Target cost/token <= $0.0007 as a realistic mid-point; if you show $0.0006 via quantization thats a plus.
- Quality: Well provide a labeled 1k test set. Success = >= 90% extraction accuracy & <= 5% false-positive rate on entity extraction.
- Security: Our InfoSec needs to review the SOC2 + retention answers before the trial. I attached the security intake questionnaire.

Timeline / ownership:
- Proposed trial window: Jun 24 -> Jul 15 (3 weeks).
- Atlas owners: Priya (PM, trial lead), Samir (Infra / data), security contact: Mina Rao (mina.rao@atlaspayments.com).
- Redwood owners: Confirmed Jordan / Marissa / Alex.

Next steps we need from Redwood:
1) Trial SOW + one-page terms (well sign a short trial agreement)  please send DocuSign link.
2) Temporary dedicated environment + credentials for our test harness.
3) Pre-populated security questionnaire responses if possible.

Ive attached the security questionnaire. Mina will join the kickoff if needed.

Thanks  looking forward to the kickoff.

Priya
Priya Shah
Senior Product Manager, Risk & Data
Atlas Payments
[Attachment: Atlas-security-questionnaire.pdf (PDF, 120 KB)]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya@atlaspayments.com>, Samir Desai <samir@atlaspayments.com>

Subject: Re: POC: Atlas Payments - success criteria & trial KPI follow-up

Priya / Samir 

Great  thanks for the confirmations and for looping Mina. Well proceed with the Jun 24 kickoff. Action items on our side and owners below: 

Redwood action owners / plan:
- Alex Martinez: provision temporary dedicated test cluster, run latency/throughput tuning, and share perf baseline (Alex will ping you directly to coordinate sample traffic ingestion).
- Marissa Cole: own evaluation harness, run the 1k test set, produce daily KPI updates (latency p95, p50, throughput, cost/token, extraction accuracy) and a final trial report.
- Jordan Blake: commercial lead  DocuSign trial SOW and follow up on contract questions.

Trial logistics / timeline:
- Kickoff: Mon, Jun 24 at 10:00 AM PT  30 min (setup + responsibilities). Ill send the calendar invite and include Mina.
- Day 0-2: environment setup & credential exchange.
- Week 1: baseline runs & initial tuning.
- Week 2: stability & throughput tests; run full 1k eval.
- Week 3: regressions, cost tuning (quantization/batching), final report and roll/no-roll recommendation.

Documents / links:
- Trial SOW (DocuSign): https://app.docusign.com/some-doc-id-ATLAS-TRIAL
- POC KPI template: https://redwood.app/docs/poc-kpi-template
- Trial plan (attached).

Attachments: Redwood-POC-trial-plan.xlsx (contains testcases + sample eval script).

Ill send the kickoff invite and DocuSign link shortly. Anything else you need added to the scope?

Thanks 

Jordan Blake
